\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 226-229 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:FA-R234-first-pass-words-from-chapters-226-229}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for life and a part.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to fertilise, to shovel, to let go, to scrub, to rinse
  \item a bandage, a painkiller, insurance, an accident, a dentist
  \item Sizdah Bedar, Chaharshanbe Suri, the New Year, the turn of the year, birth
  \item a period, a calendar, a moment, any more, dawn
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To fertilise? (\textbf{\fa{کود} \fa{دادن}}, \emph{kud dâdan}.) To shovel? (\textbf{\fa{پارو} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{pâru kardan}.) To let go? (\textbf{\fa{رها} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{rahâ kardan}.) To scrub? (\textbf{\fa{سابیدن}}, \emph{sâbidan}.) To rinse? (\textbf{\fa{آبکشی} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{âbkeshi kardan}.) A bandage? (\textbf{\fa{باند}}, \emph{bând}.) A painkiller? (\textbf{\fa{مسکن}}, \emph{mosakken}.) Insurance? (\textbf{\fa{بیمه}}, \emph{bime}.) An accident? (\textbf{\fa{تصادف}}, \emph{tasâdof}.) A dentist? (\textbf{\fa{دندانپزشک}}, \emph{dandânpezeshk}.) Sizdah Bedar? (\textbf{\fa{سیزده} \fa{بدر}}, \emph{sizdah bedar}.) Chaharshanbe Suri? (\textbf{\fa{چهارشنبه} \fa{سوری}}, \emph{chahârshanbe suri}.) The New Year? (\textbf{\fa{سال} \fa{نو}}, \emph{sâl-e now}.) The turn of the year? (\textbf{\fa{تحویل} \fa{سال}}, \emph{tahvil-e sâl}.) Birth? (\textbf{\fa{تولد}}, \emph{tavallod}.) A period? (\textbf{\fa{مدت}}, \emph{moddat}.) A calendar? (\textbf{\fa{تقویم}}, \emph{taqvim}.) A moment? (\textbf{\fa{لحظه}}, \emph{lahze}.) Any more? (\textbf{\fa{دیگر}}, \emph{digar}.) Dawn? (\textbf{\fa{سحر}}, \emph{sahar}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 230-234 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:FA-R234-second-pass-words-from-chapters-230-234}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for north and south.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item north, south, east, straight ahead, opposite
  \item a tomb, a hall, a swimming pool, homeland, birthplace
  \item a tile, a basement, a stairwell, a landing, a railing
  \item maybe, definitely, of course, probably, very
  \item a method, freedom, a war, life, a part
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
North? (\textbf{\fa{شمال}}, \emph{shomâl}.) South? (\textbf{\fa{جنوب}}, \emph{jonub}.) East? (\textbf{\fa{شرق}}, \emph{sharq}.) Straight ahead? (\textbf{\fa{مستقیم}}, \emph{mostaqim}.) Opposite? (\textbf{\fa{روبرو}}, \emph{rubaru}.) A tomb? (\textbf{\fa{آرامگاه}}, \emph{ârâmgâh}.) A hall? (\textbf{\fa{تالار}}, \emph{tâlâr}.) A swimming pool? (\textbf{\fa{استخر}}, \emph{estakhr}.) Homeland? (\textbf{\fa{وطن}}, \emph{vatan}.) Birthplace? (\textbf{\fa{زادگاه}}, \emph{zâdgâh}.) A tile? (\textbf{\fa{کاشی}}, \emph{kâshi}.) A basement? (\textbf{\fa{زیرزمین}}, \emph{zirzamin}.) A stairwell? (\textbf{\fa{راه} \fa{پله}}, \emph{râhpelle}.) A landing? (\textbf{\fa{پاگرد}}, \emph{pâgard}.) A railing? (\textbf{\fa{نرده}}, \emph{narde}.) Maybe? (\textbf{\fa{شاید}}, \emph{shâyad}.) Definitely? (\textbf{\fa{حتما}}, \emph{hatman}.) Of course? (\textbf{\fa{البته}}, \emph{albatte}.) Probably? (\textbf{\fa{احتمالا}}, \emph{ehtemâlan}.) Very? (\textbf{\fa{خیلی}}, \emph{kheyli}.) A method? (\textbf{\fa{روش}}, \emph{ravesh}.) Freedom? (\textbf{\fa{آزادی}}, \emph{âzâdi}.) A war? (\textbf{\fa{جنگ}}, \emph{jang}.) Life? (\textbf{\fa{زندگی}}, \emph{zendegi}.) A part? (\textbf{\fa{قسمت}}, \emph{qesmat}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
